units.source_text: “快了……”他用手指拎着手巾，扔到泥地间那边，

en.t: It will be soon... He pinched the towel between his fingers and tossed it over onto the muddy ground,
Yes, yes, they must be gathering everyone's opinions right now.

units.source_text: 扛着绳梯正飞跑过来吧。

en.t: They must be running here with the rope ladder on their shoulders.

units.source_text: 放任不管，倒霉的还是他们那帮人呐……

en.t: If they leave me here, they are the ones who will be in trouble...
That is how it is, isn't it...

units.source_text: 假如他们不倒霉，那也就没有必要特地张网来套住我了……”

en.t: If they would not be in trouble, then there would have been no need to go out of their way to spread a net and trap me..."
